title: Spec pin 3 (ATTACH weighting bias, rich-vs-sparse) not implemented; the weighting mechanism has no biting pin
evidence: spec _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-v2-dublin-spawn-director.md:195-197: "3. **ATTACH cluster-pick weighting:** two estates in districts of different / weights — the rich district's estate extends more (fixture with both / clusters eligible); a cluster whose district is at cap is ineligible." Implemented positive control (core/map_test.odin:506-508): "// phase 2 (the positive control): the suburb weight back to parity — / // the suburb estate extends again (the dormancy was the weight). / cat.balance.growth_districts.seed_weights[int(District_Kind.Suburb)] = 4" (city stays 4 — equal weights, not different)
detail: The spec's unequal-weight ATTACH pin is missing: phase 2 uses parity weights, phase 1 only pins zero-weight exclusion. A uniform (weight-ignoring) cluster pick passes all 8 new pins — the ATTACH weighting mechanism is unpinned.
recommended_fix: Add a step/draw-level pin with two eligible estates of unequal kind weights (e.g. 4:1) asserting the rich district's estate receives the majority of attach spawns, seed-averaged deterministically.

title: Spec pin 4 clause 'demolished terminals free the budget' has no test
evidence: spec _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-v2-dublin-spawn-director.md:198-200: "4. **Cap contract:** a district at cap blocks BOTH families (seeds go / elsewhere; the cluster is not extended); demolished terminals free the / budget." The mechanism exists unpinned (core/growth.odin:533-539): "growth_district_live_count :: proc(board: ^Map_Board, t: ^Topology, d: u16) -> i32 { / n: i32 = 0 / for i in 0..<len(t.node_alive) { / if !t.node_alive[i] || t.node_kind[i] != .Terminal { / continue". grep -rn demolish core/growth_test.odin core/map_test.odin → no district-demolition pin. PR body pin inventory omits the clause: "the district-cap contract (both families + exhaustion = ok=false + the 1-tile district)"
detail: The spec explicitly lists demolition-frees-budget as a pin; no new test demolishes terminals and asserts the district budget releases. A future refactor counting dead nodes would silently break the density ceiling contract.
recommended_fix: Extend the cap pin: fill a district to cap, assert exclusion, demolish a member terminal, assert the district becomes eligible again (seed draw succeeds / cluster extends).

title: Spec pin 1 clause 'zero-tile districts hold empty lists' untested
evidence: spec _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-v2-dublin-spawn-director.md:186-188: "   (tie-break = lower district index); every pool tile assigned to exactly / one district; per-district tile lists partition the pool; zero-tile / districts hold empty lists". Every fixture populates both districts (core/map_test.odin test_board pool, map_test.odin:38-41): "pool := [10][2]i32{ / [2]i32{2, 6}, [2]i32{10, 6}, [2]i32{6, 2}, [2]i32{6, 10}, [2]i32{6, 6}, / [2]i32{20, 6}, [2]i32{28, 6}, [2]i32{24, 2}, [2]i32{24, 10}, [2]i32{24, 6}, / }"; director_board/dense_board likewise give every district tiles
detail: The loader constructs empty lists by make(len(b.districts)) so the behavior holds by construction, but the spec's pin (a district with zero pool tiles holds an empty list and is skipped) is absent from test_map_district_assignment_partition.
recommended_fix: Add a fixture district with no pool tiles; assert its district_tiles list is empty and the seed draw never picks it.

title: PR body dual-run claim '117/119 T2 PNGs' does not reconcile with the 113 committed T2 goldens
evidence: PR body (also .memlog.md): "Proven: 117/119 T2 PNGs **pixel-identical** before/after the / re-bless; all 49 `.log.bin` differ ONLY in the 8 catalog-hash header bytes". Worktree at 93333cd: find goldens -name "*.png" | wc -l → 113 (incl. goldens/dublin_board/30000ms.png + 90000ms.png); .log.bin → 49 ✓; .t1 → 51 ✓
detail: The log.bin (49) and t1 (51) counts reconcile; the 119 T2 denominator exceeds the committed golden set by 6. The dual-run pixel-identity proof (rule 1) rests on an unexplained count.
recommended_fix: Re-run the golden gate and state the actual T2 total (113 committed, 2 dublin re-blessed) or document which 6 non-golden captures the 119 counts.
